description: Find a case from what you know about it: any of the employer's name, words of the job title and the law firm, with one filing day, a range of days or no date. One of them is enough. Each case comes with its number, status, job and filing day, and the answer says what DOL's record holds for the days read. With no employer fitting in a month or less, it returns the employers that did file in those days under a close spelling. Example: {"employer":"Acme","from":"2026-01-05","to":"2026-01-31"}.

employer.description: The employer's name, 2 to 120 characters. Inc, LLC and punctuation don't matter. With dates three months apart or less, any word of the name fits; with no dates or a longer range, the start of the name. Example: Acme.

filed.description: One filing day, from 2019-10-01 to today. Not with from or to. Example: 2026-01-30.

firm.description: The law firm's or agent's name, 2 to 120 characters. DOL names a firm only once it decides a case, so the answer holds decided cases only. Example: Fragomen.

from.description: The first filing day of a range. Alone, it is that one day. Example: 2026-01-05.

job.description: Words of the job title, up to 80 characters. Alone, with no dates, it reads the newest three months. Example: controls engineer.

program.description: Which program to search. Example: perm.

to.description: The last filing day of a range. A range longer than three months needs an employer or a firm. Example: 2026-01-31.

name: find_cases

asOf.description: The date the data is true for, YYYY-MM-DD, when one applies.

anyOf.description: Cases found without a case number, with what DOL's record holds for the days read.

items.description: One case in a search answer.

caseNumber.description: The case number as DOL prints it.

anyOf.description: The day DOL decided the case, as YYYY-MM-DD.

employer.description: The employer's name as DOL holds it.

anyOf.description: The day the case was filed, as YYYY-MM-DD.

isFinal.description: True once the case is decided or withdrawn.

jobTitle.description: The job title on the case.

lawFirm.description: The law firm on the case. DOL names it only once the case is decided.

wageRequest.description: The case number of the prevailing wage request the case used, when DOL's record names one.

worksiteState.description: The worksite's state, two letters, when DOL's record carries it.

closeNames.description: With no employer fitting in a month or less: the employers that did file in those days under a close spelling.

anyOf.description: What DOL's record holds for the days read, whatever was asked.

decided.description: How many of them DOL has decided.

filed.description: Cases filed in the days read.

day.description: The same as period, under its older name. Sent for a single-day search.

dayListCapped.description: True when a read stopped at its limit, so a case can be missing from this answer.

decidedOnly.description: True when a law firm was sent: DOL names a firm only at the decision, so no pending case can be listed.

filed.description: The one filing day read, when the search was for a single day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

alternatives.description: Other firms the same words could mean.

name.description: The firm's name as DOL's files print it.

lawFirm.description: The firm a law firm's words named, with the other firms they could mean.

lawFirmUnknown.description: True when a law firm was sent and no firm in the records matches it.

matchedEmployer.description: Cases in the days read whose employer matched the name sent.

anyOf.description: What DOL's record holds for the days read, whatever was asked.

decided.description: How many of them DOL has decided.

filed.description: Cases filed in the days read.

program.description: Which DOL program the case belongs to: perm (PERM labor certification), pwd (prevailing wage request), lca (H-1B labor condition application) or seasonal (H-2A, H-2B or CW-1).

readBy.description: How the search read: window (every case filed in the days read) or index (the employer's or firm's cases over any dates).

truncated.description: True when more cases matched than the answer lists.

window.description: The days read: from, to, and assumed when no date was sent with a job title alone.

anyOf.description: No such record. Say so; don't retry the same call.

message.description: What wasn't found and what to try, in a sentence.

data.description: The answer, or found: false when no record matched.

page.description: The page on permtracker.app that shows the same thing. Cite it.

title: Find cases without a case number
